title: Pharaoh's Folly
start: Speak to Leela outside the gates of Menaphos.

recommended.t: Activated Menaphos and Al Kharid lodestones
Sceptre of the gods or Pharaoh's sceptre
Ring of charos (a) for magic carpet ride discounts
Ring of slaying, Pollnivneach tablet, Slayer cape variant to teleport to Pollnivneach, or Pollnivneach Teleport (scroll from Treasure Trails)

rewards.t: Agility XP lamp (60000 Agility XP; requires level 50)
Thieving XP lamp (60000 Thieving XP; requires level 70)
20% less damage from Corrupted Scarabs and soul obelisks.
5% boost to the number of runes created at the soul altar, plus a 5% experience boost.
2.5x increase to reputation gain in Menaphos.
4% extra chance to save a feather of Ma'at.
5% increase in ushabti catch rate (regular and cursed).
10% increase in experience and movement ability cooldown halved in the Shifting Tombs. (Stacks with Shadow's Grace or Mobile, resulting in a cooldown of 5.4 seconds.)
Improved drop rates for objects needed for Jewels of the Elid and Insects of the Desert.

steps.t: Talk with Leela outside of the northern gates of Menaphos. [Chat: Accept › 2 We should get it over with. (Continue quest)]
Empty your backpack, worn equipment and dismiss any followers and then head to the throne room inside the Golden Palace. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to anyone inside to begin the conversation. [Chat: Any]
Attempt to exit the shifting tomb via the rope.
Search the arrow shafts to receive a mysterious message and a spare arrow shaft.
Read the mysterious message.
Speak to the four cats (indicated by yellow dots on your minimap) to receive a curved bone:
Mine crystalline corruption to obtain crystal shards.
Search treasure chests to obtain feathers.
Smash urns to obtain a gut string.
Search sarcophagi to obtain mouldy bandages. To do this, click on the panels the energy bounces off in the order of which it started.
Use the gut string on the curved bone to create a fragile bow.
Use the feathers on the spare arrow shaft to create a feathered spare arrow shaft.
Use the crystal shards on the feathered spare arrow shaft to make a scrappy arrow.
Stand next to the arrow shafts where the exit rope was, then fire arrow with the bow in your backpack.
Exit the rope.
Talk to Ozan.
Talk to Commander Akhomet outside the northern gates of Sophanem. [Chat: Any › 2 Just tell me what to do. (Continue quest) › 5 I'll crack on. (Continue quest)]
Talk to the following people:

sub.t: Maisa next to the High priest in Sophanem.
Grand Vizier Hassan in the south-west building of the Menaphos merchant district. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Lydia in Pollnivneach, south-east of Sumona.
Emir Ali Mirza in the Al Kharid palace. [Chat: 1 Yes.]

steps.t: Talk to Ozan back in the Shifting Tombs lobby. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Exit the tomb west to the Imperial district. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Sneak past the guards and enter the library.

sub.t: Head north and around the edge of the pool towards the VIP skilling area.
Go west and go behind the two guards near the Golden Palace.
Head south to the library, going behind the stationary guards. Be careful of the roaming guards who can still catch you.

steps.t: Talk to Ozan for a cutscene, and finish the dialogue to get the signal torch.
Go south and make your way to the staircase on the south side, avoiding the guard.
Stand halfway down the stairs and use the signal torch in your backpack.
Head a bit west and talk to Leela to have her follow you (you will be able to continue the next step if she gets stuck).
Continue to the bottom floor using the eastern stairs and talk to Ozan. [Chat: Any]
Speak to Leela or Ozan on the Sophanem beach. [Chat: Any]
Head to the throne room inside the Golden Palace. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to each of the members to turn the bar over their heads red. Exhausting all chat options is not required.

sub.t: Grand Vizier Ehsan. [Chat: 2 I want to call a witness. › 4 Emissary Qar › 1 Emir Ali.]
'Admiral' Wadud. [Chat: 2 I want to call a witness. › 1 Lydia › 1 Coenus' death.]
Batal. [Chat: 2 I want to call a witness. › 2 Maisa › 1 Scabaras.]
Commander Akhomet. [Chat: 2 I want to call a witness. › 3 Grand Visier Hassan › 2 Osman's strengths.]

steps.t: Re-enter the Golden Palace [Chat: 1 Go to throne room.]
Talk to Pharaoh Leela.
Quest complete!
